scripts.test:e2e: npm run e2e:db && php bin/console cache:clear --env=e2e --no-debug --quiet && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:apis
scripts.e2e:db: php bin/console doctrine:database:drop --env=e2e --force --if-exists --quiet && php bin/console doctrine:database:create --env=e2e --quiet && php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --env=e2e --no-interaction --quiet
